title: Peruvian Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew inspired by Peruvian cuisine, made with tender beef and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add cherry tomatoes, potatoes, chicken broth, aji amarillo paste, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until beef is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
